title: STILL PRESENT (r3): wrong-person leg still executes the unguarded update_reference_call_status; mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person is orphaned and its race pin is vacuous
evidence:
form_handler.gleam:1249-1257: `case sql.update_reference_call_status(config.db, id_uuid, sql.AwaitingCorrection, "", "contact_invalid", sql.ContactInitiated)` — update_reference_call_status.sql: `WHERE id = $1
  AND status = $5::reference_call_status` (no taken_over_at clause). mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person.sql HAS `AND taken_over_at IS NULL` but `grep -rn mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person server/src/` finds zero production callers; its only callers are server/test/integration/reference_checks_actions_integration_test.gleam:1746/1758 `rc_sql.mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person(db, call)` (direct SQL call, not the POST route).
detail: The guarded SQL ships but the handler still runs the unguarded UPDATE; the r3-rework only added a read-time check plus a vacuous pin. Take-over keeps status=contact_initiated (A7 stickiness), so the status-only guard still matches and yanks a taken-over row into awaiting_correction. Both mandate conditions fail.
recommended_fix: Wire apply_wrong_person's awaiting transition to sql.mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person (0-row = stand down), and make the race test drive handle_wrong_person_post with a committed take-over in between; delete the direct-SQL pin or turn it into a control.

title: STILL PRESENT (r3): spec-rc4-3-row-actions.md still names substitute_reference_call.sql and claims one additive column; the migration ships corrected_name + corrected_at
evidence: spec line 73: "`substitute_reference_call.sql` (reads the old row's slot/owner + verifies the pre-state guard)" — no such file exists in server/src/reference_checks/sql/ (substitute is implemented via insert_reference_call_if_absent + Gleam guards). spec line 232: "One additive column, nothing destructive." — supabase/migrations/20260812140000_reference_call_corrected_name.sql:13/18: `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS corrected_name TEXT,` / `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS corrected_at TIMESTAMPTZ;`
detail: Two of the three r3 spec-drift spots remain (epic-RC4-context.md effective-contact text is fixed). The PR's own spec artifact still documents files/columns that do not match the shipped implementation.
recommended_fix: Update spec-rc4-3-row-actions.md: name the actual idempotent insert (insert_reference_call_if_absent) and say two additive columns (corrected_name + corrected_at).
